system.concept: Haitian voodoo manbo Embraced and exiled to New Orleans by the Setite loa Ghede
system.biography:
Background

Manon rose to become manbo (priestess) of the Haitian voodoo cult devoted to Ezuli, a Setite worshipped by her followers as the loa of love and sex. Ezuli's own sire, the vengeful Ghede, had watched the cult for nearly two centuries plotting revenge against his renegade childe; when he discovered Manon, his fascination with her overtook his plans. Ezuli caught Ghede approaching her priestess and confronted him, and in a jealous rage Ghede nearly drained Manon to death before Ezuli slipped her own blood between the dying woman's lips, ensuring a rival claim on the new vampire. Rather than lose Manon to Ezuli outright, Ghede spirited her away to New Orleans aboard the first available ship. Manon has since built her own following in the city and is now recognized as one of the most powerful Setites in the southeastern United States, reveling in the corruption she once merely served, even as Ghede continues to nurse both his obsession with her and his hope of using her to wound Ezuli.

Roleplaying Hints

Coldly determined; you take a quiet, growing pleasure in the discomfort mortals feel around you, channeling what was once your passion for love into a passion for corruption instead.

Disciplines (as printed, dot-rating, converted to owned Discipline Items on this Actor at Storyteller discretion): Animalism 2, Auspex 3, Dominate 2, Obfuscate 3, Presence 3, Serpentis 4.
system.notes: Sire: Ezuli. Both Ezuli and Ezuli's own vengeful sire Ghede have unfinished business with Manon and may intervene in her affairs. Haven: a warehouse by the docks. Secrets rating: A-.

items.name: Serpentis — 2 Intermediate — The Form of the Cobra

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait and three full turns, you transform into a giant venomous cobra retaining your weight, able to use Disciplines that require neither hands nor speech, lasting until the next sunrise or until you revert.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next sunrise or you revert

items.name: Serpentis — 2 Intermediate — The Skin of the Adder

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait, you transform by the end of the turn into a scaled, snake-flexible hybrid form gaining the bonus Traits Lithe and Tough, an enhanced bite, and the Negative Social Traits Bestial and Repugnant, lasting until you revert or the next sunrise.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next sunrise or you revert

system.description: By hissing and baring your vampiric features in a Social Challenge, you strike terror into a victim who, if defeated, flees and avoids you for the rest of the scene or hour, risking an extra Trait to act against you if cornered.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: Once hidden from sight, you may move about at a walk and remain unnoticed, automatically becoming visible only if you speak, make loud noise, or interact with your surroundings.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: New Orleans by Night, Chapter Four: Characters
